title: Jaime's blue ball of energy during meditation

tellings.quote: this big uh blue ball I guess this like ball of energy, as he describes it, appeared.

plain: In the 1970s, while meditating in the lab of a researcher named Puharich, a man called Jaime is said to have seen "this big blue ball" appear, which he described as a ball of energy. The story comes from an unnamed researcher who was a guest on the show, passing on what Jaime and Puharich's assistant reported. It is told as a sign that the lab's work brought something unexplained into the room.
